pages.text: There was a bridge over the canal. It curved up in the middle.
Pongi got on her bicycle. "I'm going to ride up without getting off once."
She pedaled. The bridge got steeper and steeper.
Pongi was out of breath. Still, she kept her feet moving.
Dad followed behind. "Let's go slowly and enjoy the view."
Dad stopped to watch the ducks. He waited until every duck had gone past.
Pongi reached the top. "I didn't get off once!"
Dad wasn't even halfway up yet. He was pushing his bicycle up the bridge.
Now it was time to go down. The path stretched straight downhill.
Dad whizzed past Pongi. Pongi still hadn't put her feet down.
